title: Codex fails to load its config when a model provider still sets wire_api = "chat"
symptoms: failed to load Codex config, and codex doctor reports config could not be loaded
A Chat Completions-only proxy that worked before stops working after a Codex upgrade
The failure happens even when the provider entry is unused
cause: Current Codex releases support only Responses API endpoints for custom providers; wire_api chat and Chat Completions-only gateways are no longer accepted.
fix: Point the provider at a Responses-compatible endpoint with wire_api responses, put a Responses-compatible gateway in front of the old one, or delete the stale provider entry.
affected: Codex CLI 0.59 and later dropped chat for most uses; config load failure reported on 0.151.0; as of 2026-10
